content.title: Nippon Steel settles disputes with USW, Cliffs over U.S. Steel deal
content.summary: The settlement includes the dismissal of a lawsuit brought by Nippon Steel, its North America unit and U.S. Steel against USW President David McCall, as well as the withdrawal of an unfair labor practice charge the union had filed against U.S. Steel with the National Labor Relations Board.  The companies also dropped claims involving Cleveland-Cliffs and its CEO Lourenco Goncalves, who had opposed the deal.
